finding: EG-19 declared decision scope and revision evidence
original_requirement: Supply relevant prior rulings with explicit scope, evidence and revision applicability; retain findings when code changes.
before: Standalone decisions rely on prose mentions. Events cannot retain explicit file scope, reviewed commit and conditions, and review cannot compare source against the declared decision revision.
after: Decision records retain optional exact file scope, reviewed commit and complete conditions without changing legacy event serialization.
Review discovers explicitly scoped decisions even without prose path mentions, and excludes unrelated explicit scopes.
Review reports baseline/current source hashes, changed/unchanged/unavailable bytes and submitted-change reassessment; matching HEAD or unapplied disk state never suppresses current findings.
limits: Declared scope and provenance do not authenticate decision authority or semantically establish that conditions hold. No automatic exception suppression.
Source comparisons use raw bytes including line endings and only submitted intersecting paths. Legacy records remain unscoped; no inferred backfill.
Old binaries reject decision records containing the new optional scope field. Production records are unchanged by verification; rollback after recording scoped decisions is not established.
Acceptance uses owned WebForms-shaped source and independent Git/content oracles, not a measured OciusX implementation or productivity benefit.
CodeRabbit host authentication unavailable; parent manual review only. Wider EG19 authority/applicability and original broader gates remain open.

resources.retention: Retain receipts, wire/oracles and rollback pair; no preexisting directory deletion.
